description: This file defines the NoteRepository interface which extends JpaRepository, providing methods for querying Note entities, including criteria for archived status and title content.

classes.name: NoteRepository
classes.description: Repository interface for Note entity enabling CRUD operations and custom queries based on archived status and title.

methods.name: findByArchived
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notes filtered by archived status.

methods.name: findByArchivedAndTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notes filtered by archived status and title containing a specified string, case-insensitive.

methods.name: findByTitleContainingIgnoreCase
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of notes where the title contains the specified string, case-insensitive.
